Southern Territory's Highest Percentage MNPL Sponsoring Members
posts.body:
We were recently served this award by the IAM Southern Territory for having the highest percentage of sponsoring members in the entire Southern Territory. That is a valued accomplishment we are proud of. We have always been a high contributing Local. We know we can expand on our accomplishment. We are challenging all Local 1720 Officers and Stewards to pledge to being MNPL Sponsors. We also ask all of you to join us. This will be a highly contested award in the coming years, and we want to keep the top spot.  IAM 1720 members who contribute at least $30 per year to MNPL become sponsors. It's easy to become a sponsor through a $1 per week payroll deduction. Any officer or steward can get you a card to fill out. You may want to just contribute $30 annually, we have envelopes for that as well. More information can be found [HERE](https://www.goiam.org/mnpl/)! If you want to contribute online, make sure you fill in all the information so our Local get credit for your sponsorship!

![](/assets/images/uploads/l1720mnpl.png)
